plotSections.title: Walker’s side trip setup
bullets: Walker confirms Plymouth Gawater is with him before resuming play.
Walker uses his small portal cube to pop out in The Reach near the Whispering Abyss.
Sylan notes Walker can navigate by mind link and does not need sight for where he is going; Sylan treats the outing as a short, low-risk adventure.

plotSections.title: Route to the Dragon Rider training guild
bullets: From the Whispering Abyss, Walker plans to fly north toward the Lost Isles area to reach the Dragon Rider training grounds.
The DM places the training guild on the largest unnamed island dead center in the hex between the Lost Islands, Camp Two, and the Howling tunnels.
Elrus had previously said Last Word Chasm to the training grounds is about five days by flight.

Walker initially estimates about eight days from the Whispering Abyss; the DM agrees the distance is close enough and treats the straight-line flight as essentially the same, settling on about five days.

plotSections.title: Dragon energy and exhaustion planning
bullets: Walker reviews his dragon-riding energy rules: every five energy spent adds one level of exhaustion, rounded down.
A long rest removes only one exhaustion level, so stacking multiple levels in one day is inefficient unless timed carefully.
The DM advises taking any bulk exhaustion on the first day rather than the last, so a rest before arrival does not leave Walker impaired on arrival.
Walker plans to spend five energy per travel day, accepting one exhaustion level per day for the roughly five-day flight.

chronologicalEvents: Walker confirms Plymouth Gawater is accompanying him.
After a brief out-of-game break, Walker uses his portal cube and pops out near the Whispering Abyss in The Reach.
Walker locates the Reach map and confirms the exit point with the DM.
The party identifies the flight destination as the Dragon Rider training grounds near the Lost Isles.
The DM specifies the guild sits on the largest unnamed island in the hex between the Lost Islands, Camp Two, and the Howling tunnels.
Walker recalls Elrus’s estimate of about five days from Last Word Chasm to the training grounds and proposes about eight days from the Whispering Abyss.
The DM accepts about five days of flight as close enough for travel time.
Walker and the DM review exhaustion rules for dragon energy expenditure.
Walker decides to spend five energy per day and take one exhaustion level per day for the journey.

Walker.existing: Half-elf dragon rider and fighter bonded to Glimmen, Gatekeeper of The Reach.
notes: Is traveling with Plymouth Gawater on a short side excursion.
Uses a small portal cube to exit into The Reach near the Whispering Abyss.
Is planning a multi-day dragon flight north to the Dragon Rider training grounds.
Dragon riding costs five energy per day on this trip, producing one level of exhaustion per day under current rules.
Plans to accept one exhaustion level per travel day rather than stacking exhaustion late in the journey.

Plymouth Gawater.existing: Gnome artificer and party ally who explains keystone lore and guides the keepers.
notes: Is present with Walker for this Reach excursion.

Dragon Rider Training Grounds.existing: Dragon Rider guild training grounds near the Lost Isles.
notes: Located on the largest unnamed island in the relevant Reach hex, positioned between the Lost Islands, Camp Two, and the Howling tunnels.
About five days of dragon flight from the Whispering Abyss under the travel time agreed in session.

Whispering Abyss.existing: A location near where the party previously emerged from the arch.
notes: Walker and Plymouth pop out here when Walker uses his portal cube.

The Reach.existing: The largest Arch realm of Atlas, which Walker gatekeeps and explores by flight.
notes: Walker's portal exit places him on the Reach map near the Whispering Abyss.
The training guild destination lies in a hex containing the Lost Islands, Camp Two, and the Howling tunnels.

Elrus.existing: Walker's hidden ally in the coming confrontation.
notes: Previously told Walker that flight from Last Word Chasm to the training grounds takes about five days.

Last Word Chasm.existing: A long-uninhabited roost associated with Grixto.
notes: Used as a travel-time reference point: about five days by flight to the Dragon Rider training grounds per Elrus.
